title: C20 TRINITY ACCRETION ECHO engineering data contract
description: Proposed record contract. No data have been collected by this generator. Null is missing/unknown and must be qualified in the separate provenance record.

population_draw.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.

variability_law.x-quality-rule: Never labeled native TRINITY time evolution.

tau_sigma.x-encoding: posterior record: representation is explicit; weights and sample dimensions require domain validation.
tau_sigma.x-quality-rule: Positive timescale; convention of X explicit.

epoch_window.x-quality-rule: Missing epochs absent; time origin/scale recorded.

redshift.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.

host_flux.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.
host_flux.x-quality-rule: Add in flux space with shared uncertainty.

lightcurve_cov.x-quality-rule: PSD and covariance validity checks required.

autocorrelation.x-encoding: measurement value encoded directly; qualifier, uncertainty, calibration and model version are in the provenance sidecar.
autocorrelation.description: Selected ensemble temporal correlation by lag.
autocorrelation.x-quality-rule: Population weights and lag exposure recorded.

x-unit-policy: Use documented units; do not replace missing values with zero. Reference frames, covariance basis, calibration version and quality qualifiers reside in the provenance sidecar.
x-domain-validation: Physical range, covariance validity and declared quality rules require domain validation beyond JSON Schema.
